scope: Additive v5 replacement of all 18 N08-B09 questions after independent identity adjudication: operation-ID retry policy replaces the before objects’ owner-boundary decision. items.learningObjective: Choose a retry identity that resolves one operation’s uncertain outcome without merging a distinct later operation.
items.decisiveFact: On a public-transit disruption board, each platform change has a stable change ID and effective sequence. A controller can lose its acknowledgement after submitting a change, and another change to that same platform may be valid later. Which policy should govern a retry?
items.nearestAlternative: Retry each submission under a fresh change ID.
items.identityReason: The manifest-bound before item ood-n08-b09-i001 asks where the retry/idempotency invariant belongs and keys the answer to the enforcing object boundary (“Make a retry key or idempotent state transition part of the object boundary before adding automatic retries. In this case, that keeps the rule “passengers receive the change in the order in which it becomes effective” inside the owner that can observe and enforce it.”). This question instead asks which identity recovers one uncertain operation while keeping a later operation distinct (“Replay by change ID and read its sequence result; handle a later platform edit as another operation.”). The primary choice changed from ownership placement to operation-ID retry policy; the reserved replacement question ID is therefore used. Every option has a fresh ID because this is a replacement question.
